issues.location: initial value of tau iteration and claimed strict bound on tau(A)
issues.finding: With tau_0(A)=card(A), an input whose cardinality is already a beth fixed point yields tau(A)=card(A), contradicting the claimed strict inequality card(A)<tau(A).
issues.proposed_resolution: Seed tau_0(A) with the successor cardinal of card(A), so tau(A) is a beth fixed point strictly larger than card(A).

issues.location: initial value of W and its asserted range of beth fixed points
issues.finding: The source sets W_0=0, which is not a beth fixed point, although it then calls W an injection from all ordinals into beth fixed points. Its limit-stage preservation of fixed points is also left unstated.
issues.proposed_resolution: Set W_0=tau(0) and note that the increasing union of beth fixed points at a limit stage is again fixed by continuity of the beth sequence.

translation_treatment: The target starts tau above the input cardinal, starts W at a beth fixed point, explains limit closure, and localizes the two Boolos page citations. The frozen source remains unchanged.
